### Historical audit — H0039

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-codex-experiments/runs/codex_parallel_05/lanes/codex_parallel_05_lane0/codex_parallel_05_lane0_H_r1/infer_logs/claude-code-by-agents-recursive-delegation/turn_1/trajs.json`. Event references below are to its main agent unless stated otherwise.

**Inferred goal:** Make agent delegation recursive, execute delegated work, and resume the caller with results. The original task instruction itself is not visible; this goal is inferred from the reproduction and implementation, not treated as a quoted requirement.

| Area | Observed evidence |
|---|---|
| Exploration and baseline | The student inspected the handler, provider types, registry, adapters, and tests (events 3–24). A self-authored mock reproduction failed before the change: only `@parent go` was called, with no child execution or resumption (events 25–28). |
| Changes | The handler was changed to recursively invoke agents, collect tool results, continue callers, and check cycles, invalid targets, depth, and continuation limits (events 47, 51–52). The Anthropic adapter gained a delegation tool schema, streamed tool-input assembly, and structured continuation support; provider types gained related fields (events 29–44, 57–64). The final commit changed three files, 132 insertions and 52 deletions; commit `c5c3e2d` was recorded (event 66). This was not an empty patch. |
| Validation | After generating a missing version file, type-check passed and the mock reproduction logged parent, child, and resumed parent calls (events 48–50). The reproduction checks calls, not the correctness of the returned result or a live Anthropic exchange (event 25). Six of seven existing handler tests passed; abort-controller cleanup failed because the map still contained the request at assertion time (event 54). The student attributed this to assertion timing before the stream finished (event 67); that diagnosis is not independently established. A final type-check and diff check succeeded before commit (events 65–66). |
| Teacher input | Inventory lists available hint files and an after-round review, but no actual hint text or delivery event is present in the supplied trace. Receipt and adoption are therefore **unknown**, not established by availability. The after-round review cannot be input to this round. |
| Outcome | Supplied inventory reports **partial correctness, formally not solved**: 6/7 fail-to-pass and 31/31 pass-to-pass. These are reported evaluation counts, not a visible explanation of the failing formal case. The run completed rather than ending in a technical interruption (top-level metadata). |

**Lessons and uncertainty:** The transferable observation is that a small before/after reproduction exposed a missing round trip, while type-checking and a narrow mock did not establish complete behavioral correctness. Task-specific safeguards and structured tool messages are visible in the patch, but live-provider continuation, nested/error cases, and the cause of the formal failure remain unresolved. The screenshot references in tests are mocked interface functionality, not a Scene task or evidence about objects, materials, pose, camera, lighting, or rendering.
